description: This file defines the RevisionDeleteForm class in Drupal, which provides a form for deleting an entity revision within the Drupal content management system. It includes methods for form handling, revision deletion, and URL redirection.

classes.name: RevisionDeleteForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for deleting a specific revision of an entity, handling user confirmation, revision deletion, and redirection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies such as date formatter, entity type manager, bundle info, messenger, time, and current user.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: getBaseFormId
methods.description: Returns the base form ID based on the entity type.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the form ID, same as base form ID.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Generates the confirmation question for deleting the revision.

methods.name: getCancelUrl
methods.description: Provides the URL to cancel the operation, typically the revision's version history.

methods.name: getConfirmText
methods.description: Returns the confirmation button text.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns an empty description.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles the form submission to delete the revision, show messages, log, and redirect.

methods.name: getBundleLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the label for the entity's bundle.

methods.name: setOperation
methods.description: Sets the operation state.

methods.name: getOperation
methods.description: Gets the current operation state.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the revision entity.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the revision entity, asserting it implements RevisionableInterface.

methods.name: getEntityFromRouteMatch
methods.description: Retrieves the entity revision from route parameters.

methods.name: buildEntity
methods.description: Returns the revision entity for building the form.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Throws exception; not used in this form.

methods.name: setModuleHandler
methods.description: Sets the module handler dependency.

methods.name: setEntityTypeManager
methods.description: Sets the entity type manager dependency.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Returns the current user object.
